sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(date_diff('day', received_at, decided_at)), 1) AS avg_turnaround_days FROM caseflow.cases WHERE decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
explanation: The average number of days from receiving an application to deciding it, for applications decided in October 2026.
assumptions: Turnaround is the calendar days from received_at to decided_at
Averaged over applications decided in October 2026
